verdict.rationale: Stripe's Connect disputes docs say all disputes filed against the platform and its connected accounts can be viewed in the Dashboard, which supports per-seller dispute visibility. Nothing in the pack covers the rest of the story: evidence submission, or dispute outcomes being debited from or credited to seller balances. Missing for 10: documented evidence submission via API or Dashboard, automatic flow of dispute outcomes into connected-account balances, explicit routing of chargebacks to the correct sub-merchant by charge type, independent or hands-on corroboration.
